about.tagline: Building scalable, clean, and efficient web solutions.
about.summary: Full Stack Developer based in Medellín, Colombia, focused on turning complex problems into simple, reliable web products. I work across the whole stack — from accessible, type-safe React and Next.js interfaces to well-structured Node.js and .NET services backed by PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
about.body: I enjoy breaking down ambiguous problems into small, testable pieces and shipping solutions that are easy to read and easy to maintain. I care about strong typing, sensible architecture and measurable performance — and I keep learning new tools through side projects and code reviews.
